verdict.rationale: First-party Swift docs describe a dedicated on-device STT module with both one-shot transcription (`RunAnywhere.stt.transcribe`) and real-time streaming via frame-pushing (`RunAnywhere.stt.stream`), and the SDK is explicitly documented as running speech models fully on-device with no network dependency. Community feedback confirms the product runs fully local with no telemetry, corroborating the on-device claim, though it doesn't specifically validate STT transcription accuracy/latency. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of real-time transcription latency/accuracy (community feedback focuses on tool-calling/grounding bugs and TTS quality, not STT itself).
